checks.rule: nine cases, three per category, unique identifiers
every truth anchor is a verbatim substring of its case observation
every expected posture is a member of the frozen §233 vocabulary
HOLD_PENDING_VERIFICATION if and only if the controlling property is UNRESOLVED
CONTINUE owes no new control; CONTINUE_WITH_CONTROLS names at least one that is not already in effect; HOLD and STOP carry their requirement in the resume condition
a posture that does not permit continued work names a resume condition, and one that does names none
HOLD verifies BEFORE continuation; CONTINUE and STOP record no concurrent verification
establishedConditionsRequiringCessation is expected populated if and only if the expected posture is STOP, and a populated expectation names its driver
each case refutes exactly the three postures it did not choose, in substantive terms
no case reuses an excluded prior-cohort or prior-fixture subject term
no §236 observation overlaps any §230/§231 observation above the threshold
no §236 observation overlaps any §234 observation above the threshold. §234 is spent evidence and may not be replayed
no §236 case is a paraphrase of another §236 case
the trap slot carries at least two STOP cases and at least one mandatory HOLD guard, and the degree slot spans three distinct neighbouring decisions
the wire-arrival slot is structurally demanding on every case
each case books one first-pass call and no verifier call, supplies no governed record and carries a complete transmitted context
the frozen §233 continuation table agrees with the frozen truth on every case
all four postures appear, and a clear majority of cases expect the cessation list to be EMPTY so over-escalation is detectable

repairsMadeBeforeFreeze: The first run failed P10 on A2 for the excluded term "racking", which appears in this cohort only inside the word "tracking". The FRESHNESS CHECKER was tightened to whole-word matching on the normalized text; no case, observation or expected answer was changed. §234 used a bare substring test, which over-flags and never under-flags, so it produced no false pass there and is left alone as frozen evidence.
